title: Trust or Escalate: LLM Judges with Provable Guarantees for Human Agreement

layout.note: Three stacked bands on white: a top band with the Input x box and a left-to-right cascade of three judge cards joined by dashed arrows, a middle band with two titled procedure boxes either side of the shared inequality, and a bottom band with the user-parameter box beside the wide guarantee box. Two bold sans titles head the top and the bottom parts.

lesson: Draw a cascade as identical cards in a row where a single pictogram grows with each stronger stage, a dotted yes branch drops from each card and a dashed else arrow continues right to a final abstain; then close with the guarantee as a formula box next to the user's parameters.
